kind_note: Not a campaign.py campaign and no search. An offline placement pass over run frontiers the FRETISH ablation campaign (campaign/fretish-ablation) already wrote, run by hand: locally on 2026-10-01/02 under systemd-run memory caps, and the lpc-full-core1 remainder on av3 as user service fp-lpcw from 2026-10-02 13:50. Driven from the scratch scripts vendored under scripts/.
question: Can the paired directed-vs-uniform joint-frontier table (paper RQ fretish, data/fretish-ablation-2026-09/overlap.csv) be filled for the four subjects its exact pass skipped as too costly: liquid-mixer, lpc-mini-core1, lpc-full-core1 and valu3s-uc6?
method: Hybrid placement (scripts/hybrid.py). Each frontier member is evaluated on sampled lasso words; a word satisfying x and violating y refutes x => y soundly, so a pair refuted both ways is proven incomparable. Every other pair, within and across arms, goes to compare --timeout 20 (the exact pass's per-query budget); a timeout reads as non-implication, as in maximal. With LTL set, a compare timeout falls back to black text-mode solve on each direction. Placement reproduces paired.py's convention by running maximal on each multi-spelling equivalence class. Words: black models of random frontier repairs with random literal hints (draw_black.py), boundary words A & G\{g} & !g (lpc-full only), and per-pair witness models of x & !y (pairwit.py); fpdraw eval re-evaluates every word.

validation.files: data/hyb/fix-*.csv (mode-arbiter and RAD cores, unglued fingerprints over clean words) and data/hyb/full-*.csv (other subjects), checked by scripts/check.py against data/exact.csv
validation.differences: 1 compare timeout (fsm-timing seed 9); 8 from the start_of_mode glued-X bug in the exact pass (fixed on main in 5dc3472): maximal-unglued reproduces the hybrid on 8/8 (data/redo-maximal-unglued.csv), shipped maximal reproduces exact.csv on 8/8 (data/redo-maximal.csv)
validation.cost: 2.89% of pairs reached compare; 0.60 h wall against 2.13 h for the exact pass

caveats: compare timeouts read as non-implication, so dominated shares are lower bounds and move with host load: two lpc-mini-core1 runs differ on 21 of 30 seeds (uniform dominated 16.1% vs 13.2%; the earlier run is data/hyb/lpc-mini-core1.csv).
valu3s-uc6's zero dominated shares mean no domination is provable: the 0.22% of pairs words leave also time out in compare at 300 s (24/24 sampled) and in black.
black -o json reports UNSAT at its -t timeout; only black text output is trusted (hybrid.py). pairwit.py's UNSAT tallies include timeouts; its SAT witness words are unaffected.
black -m models with loop == size are dropped; 1,077 such words reached early RAD/takeoff runs, whose outputs were redone (data/hyb/fixbad, v1 hold superseded outputs).
shared counts structurally identical members only (paired.py convention); sem_* columns give the semantic reading, median shared 0.52% vs 0% over the 16 validated subjects.

TIMEOUT=20 WORKERS=6 [LTL=<dump>] python3 scripts/hybrid.py <fp-dir> <subject> <out.csv> <run-dirs>... with the run directories in place (paths in the .list and .ltl files must be rewritten to where they sit).
